task:
Create a DaemonSet named 'node-monitor' in namespace 'kube-system' that:
  - Uses image: busybox:1.35
  - Runs on every node including control plane nodes
  - Command: ['/bin/sh', '-c', 'while true; do echo "Node monitoring..."; sleep 60; done']
  - Has a toleration for: key=node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane, effect=NoSchedule

DaemonSets ensure exactly one pod per node. The control-plane toleration is needed
to schedule on the master node which has a NoSchedule taint by default.
hints: kubectl does not have a 'create daemonset' shortcut — write YAML directly
Add spec.template.spec.tolerations to run on control plane
detailed_hints: Start from a Deployment YAML and change kind to DaemonSet

validators.description: DaemonSet has at least one pod running
validators.command: kubectl get daemonset node-monitor -n kube-system -o jsonpath='{.status.numberReady}'
